rules.expr: sum by (cluster, node) (count_over_time({cluster="main",node="talosm03",source="talos",talos_service="kernel"} |~ "rcu: INFO: rcu_preempt (self-detected stall on CPU|detected (expedited )?stalls on CPUs/tasks)" [5m])) > 0

annotations.description: Check recent Talos kernel lines for the CPU, stack and recurrence. Check this node's RBD in-flight I/O, read/write completions and service checks. Kubernetes Ready may still be true.
